y-m-59-11.title: Ma isla'egtu gabi ahaanba waa la xalliyey sababtoo ah laba xal ayaa la helay?
y-m-59-11.goal: Ogow in xalalku baaba'i karaan inta isla'egta la beddelayo, oo xukun tirada xalalka adigoo isbarbar dhigaya habab kala duwan oo aan ka tagin xalal kala duwanaanshaha ku jira.
y-m-59-11.material:
Waxaad rabtaa inaad hesho xalalka isla'egta sin x = sin 2x ee 0 ≤ x ≤ 2π (labada dhamaad waa lagu daray, x u tiri tirooyin dhab ah oo kala duwan). (Akhriska: sine x la simanyahay sine 2x.) Jimin sidan ayay u xalisay.

"Labada dhinac u qaybi sin x si aad u hesho 1 = 2 cos x, sidaa darteed cos x = 1/2. 0 ≤ x ≤ 2π, x leh cos x = 1/2 waa π/3 iyo 5π/3, sidaa darteed waxaa jira laba xal."

y-m-59-11.s.s1.prompt: Xogta waxaa la muujiyaa hal-hal. Mar kasta dooro fikirkaaga ku saabsan xalka Jimin.
y-m-59-11.s.s1.hint.0: Geli macluumaadka cusub ee tallaabo kasta si toos ah isla'egta asalka ah sin x = sin 2x.
y-m-59-11.s.s1.hint.1: Ka raadi kala duwanaanshaha qiimayaasha halka tirada aad u qaybineyso ay noqon karto 0.
y-m-59-11.s.s1.st.0.info: Xalka Jimin waa kan kor ku xusan. Haddii aad labada xal π/3 iyo 5π/3 geliso isla'egta asalka ah, dhab ahaan way run yihiin.
y-m-59-11.s.s1.st.0.ask: Sidee u xukuntaa gunaanadka Jimin 'waxaa jira saxda laba xal'?
y-m-59-11.s.s1.st.0.after: Waxaan xaqiijinay in labada xal run yihiin, laakiin maadaama labada dhinac loo qaybiyey sin x, suurtagalnimada in xalal baaba'een weli lama baarin.
y-m-59-11.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Waa sax. Wuu qaybiyey oo xaliyey, labada xal na run ayay yihiin, sidaa darteed waxaa jira saxda laba xal
y-m-59-11.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Waxaad u malaysay in xaqiiqda ah labada xal run yihiin ay xaqiijisay xataa gunaanadka 'wax kale ma jiraan'. Helitaanka xalalka run ah waa ka duwan yahay helitaanka dhammaan xalalka.
y-m-59-11.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Waxaa jira wax ka yar laba xal. Kaliya hal ayaa sax ah
y-m-59-11.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Waxaa la bixiyey in labada xal run yihiin. Waxay ka hor imanaysaa macluumaadka la bixiyey.
y-m-59-11.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Xalalka la helay waa sax, laakiin waxaa jiri kara xalal la seegay, sidaa darteed hubin ayaa loo baahan yahay
y-m-59-11.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Waxaad kala saartay xal run ah iyo 'helitaanka dhammaan xalalka'. Waa dabeecadda hubinta in wax is beddelaan inta beddelka lagu jiro.
y-m-59-11.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Ma ogaan karno haddii aynaan si toos ah u tirin isgoysyada garaaf
y-m-59-11.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Waxaad soo jeedisay hab hubin toos ah halkii aad ka xaqiijin lahayd xalka oo keliya. Ka fikir in lagu hubin karo habka aljabrada sidoo kale.
y-m-59-11.s.s1.st.1.info: Macluumaad cusub: haddii aad x = 0 geliso isla'egta asalka ah, sin 0 = 0 iyo sin 0 = 0, sidaa darteed waa run. Haddii aad geliso x = π, sin π = 0 iyo sin 2π = 0, sidaa darteed waa run.
y-m-59-11.s.s1.st.1.ask: Sidee ayuu xukunkaaga xalka Jimin ugu beddelmaa macluumaadkan?
y-m-59-11.s.s1.st.1.after: x = 0 iyo x = π waxay buuxiyaan isla'egta asalka ah, sidaa darteed waa xalal. Si labada dhinac loogu qaybiyo sin x, waxaa loo baahan yahay sin x ≠ 0, laakiin qaybinta lama oggola x leh sin x = 0 (0, π, 2π), sidaa darteed xaaladdaas waa in si gooni ah loo baaraa.
y-m-59-11.s.s1.st.1.o.a: x = 0 iyo x = π waxay run yihiin kadis, sidaa darteed uma baahnin inaan u tirinno xalal
y-m-59-11.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Haddii ay run tahay marka isla'egta asalka ah la geliyo, waa xal. Ka fikir in halbeeg jiro oo xal loogu reebi karo sida kadis.
y-m-59-11.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Labada xal ee Jimin waa khalad
y-m-59-11.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Macluumaadka cusubi waa inay jiraan xalal kale, ee maaha in xalalka Jimin khalad yihiin.
y-m-59-11.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Gunaanadka Jimin waa khalad. Aad ayay u suurtagal tahay in xalalka leh sin x = 0 ay baaba'een markii la qaybinayay
y-m-59-11.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Waxaad ku xidhay sababta xalalku u baaba'i karaan qaybinta. Waxaad hagaajisay xukunkaaga adigoo ku salaynaya macluumaadka cusub ee aad ku hubisay gelinta qiimayaal run ah.
y-m-59-11.s.s1.st.1.o.d: Xitaa xalalka cusub, gabagabada Jimin weli waa sax
y-m-59-11.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Ma hubin haddii macluumaadka cusubi uu gilgilo 'si sax ah laba'. Mar kale tiri imisa xal ayaa jira.
y-m-59-11.s.s1.st.2.info: Macluumaad cusub: sin x − sin 2x = sin x − 2 sin x cos x = sin x (1 − 2 cos x). Si ay u noqoto 0, mid ka mid ah sin x = 0 ama 1 − 2 cos x = 0 waa inuu run noqdaa.
y-m-59-11.s.s1.st.2.ask: Imisa xal ayuu isla'egtani leeyahay wadar ahaan 0 ≤ x ≤ 2π?
y-m-59-11.s.s1.st.2.after: Haddii sin x = 0, markaas x = 0, π, 2π, haddii cos x = 1/2 na, x = π/3, 5π/3. Qiimayaal is-dulsaaraya ma jiraan, sidaas darteed waxaa jira 5 wadar ahaan. (Haddii xadku ahaa 0 ≤ x < 2π, 2π waa laga tagaa, taasoo siinaysa 4.)
y-m-59-11.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Ma tirin xalalka kiiska sin x = 0, ama waxaad raacday gabagabada Jimin. Hel x leh sin x = 0 xadka.
y-m-59-11.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Tani waa kiiska dhammaadyada xadka 0 iyo 2π loo tiriyey hal bar. Hawshani waxay tidhi tiri x sida tirooyin dhab ah oo kala duwan.
y-m-59-11.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Waxaa laga yaabaa inaad laba jeer tirisay xalalka. Liis geli xalalka kiis kasta mid mid xadka dhexdiisa oo hubi haddii qiimayaal is-dulsaaraan.
y-m-59-11.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Waxaad isku dartay xalalka leh sin x = 0 (0, π, 2π) iyo xalalka leh cos x = 1/2 (π/3, 5π/3). Waxaad u kala qaybisay kiisas oo mid kasta si gooni ah ayaad u tiriseen.
y-m-59-11.s.s1.reflect: Bilowgii, sidee ayaad u xukuntay markaad aragtay 'labada xal labaduba waa run'? Maxaa isbeddelay ka dib markaad aragtay macluumaadka cusub? Sidee ayuu 'xalalka la helay waa sax' uga duwan yahay 'xalalka oo dhan waa la helay'?

y-m-59-11.s.s2.o.b: Wax walba hal dhinac u rar, qodobee, oo u kala qaybi kiisaska wax-isku-dhufashadu yahay 0
y-m-59-11.s.s2.r.b: Tani waa hab qodobaya adigoon qaybin oo helaya labada kiis. Haddii aad seegtay habkan, mar kale eeg macluumaadka tallaabadii ka horreysay.

y-m-59-11.s.s2.r.c: Waxaad ku xukuntay haddii uu dhammaystiran yahay tirada xalalka la helay. Xalalka la helay oo run ahaanshahoodu way ka duwan yihiin helitaanka xalalka oo dhan.
y-m-59-11.s.s2.o.d: Sawir garaafyada labada shaqo oo tiri tirada is-goynta
y-m-59-11.s.s2.r.d: Tani waa hab ku hubiya xalalka is-goynta garaafka halkii xisaab aljebra ah. Haddii aad seegtay habkan, ka fikir waxa xalalka isla'egtu yihiin garaafka.
y-m-59-11.s.s2.o.e: U qaybi labada dhinac sin x oo xalli, ka dibna ku dar x = 0 oo keliya sida xalka maqan
y-m-59-11.s.s2.r.e: Waxaad dhammaystirtay qaar oo keliya ka mid ah xalalka la seegay. Hel x oo dhan xadka leh sin x = 0.

y-m-59-08.title: Qaacidada wadarta runtii ma sax baa sababtoo ah waxay ku sax tahay n = 1?
y-m-59-08.topic: Wadarrada adigoo isticmaalaya sifooyinka sigma (calaamadda wadarta)
y-m-59-08.goal: Xal isticmaalaya sifooyinka sigma, hel sadarka si khaldan ugu maamulay wadarka eraygii joogtada ahaa, kala saar qiime (n = 1) halka tibaax khaldan si kadis ah u muuqato sax iyo qiime muujiya khaladka, oo hagaaji habka hubinta.
y-m-59-08.material: Hayun waxay u qortay qiimaha Σ_{k=1}^{n} (2k + 1) sida tibaax ku saabsan n. (Akhriska: sigma, k laga bilaabo 1 ilaa n, 2k ku dar 1. Taasi waa, wadarka 3 + 5 + 7 + … + (2n + 1).) Dhammaadka xalka, Hayun waxay qortay, "Waxaan geliyey n = 1 wuxuuna la simanyahay 3, wadarka aan si toos ah u helay, sidaa darteed waa sax."

y-m-59-08.s.s1.explain: Sadarka 2, Σ_{k=1}^{n} 1 waa 1 oo n jeer la isku daray, sidaa darteed waa inuu noqdaa n, laakiin waxaa loo qoray 1. Sadarka 1 (sifada sigma) waa sax. Sadarrada 3 iyo 4 waxay sidii ay yihiin sii wataan khaladka sadarka 2. Hubinta sadarka 5 waxay kadis u sax tahay n = 1, sidaa darteed khaladka ma muujiso.

y-m-59-13.goal: Ku xaqiiji kiisas in barbar dhigga cabbirka logarithm-yada uu ku xidhan yahay xadka salka, sheeg shuruudda sheegashada 'haddii qiimaha log uu weyn yahay, x sidoo kale way weyn tahay' run ku tahay, oo naftaada dhis tusaalayaal labada kiis.
y-m-59-13.material:
Jaehee wuxuu yiri, "Haddii log_a x > log_a 3, markaas x > 3." (Akhris: haddii log salka a ee x ka weyn yahay log salka a ee 3.) Salka a waa a > 0, a ≠ 1, xujadda x na waa x > 0. 
  
 Jadwalka waxaa ku jira dhowr qiime. 
 Salka 2: log_2 1 = 0, log_2 2 = 1, log_2 4 = 2, log_2 3 ≈ 1.58 
 Salka 1/2: log_(1/2) 1 = 0, log_(1/2) 2 = −1, log_(1/2) 4 = −2, log_(1/2) 3 ≈ −1.58

y-m-59-03.goal: Marka qiimaha logarithm-ka caadiga ah uu yahay qiyaas la wareejiyey, ku xukun haddii xadka khaladkiisu go'aamiyo gabagabada (tirada lambarrada) sida hal qiime, oo sheeg sida sax ah ee qiyaasta loo baahan yahay in la ogaado si gabagabada loo go'aamiyo.
y-m-59-03.material:
Waxaad rabtaa inaad adigoo isticmaalaya logarithms ogaato imisa lambar ayuu 2^100 leeyahay. Ha isticmaalin xisaabiye.

 Akhri xadka ay qiyaasi bixiso sidan. Tusaale: 'la wareejiyey ilaa meesha tobanaad ee koowaad, 0.3' macnaheedu waa qiimaha dhabta ahi waa ugu yaraan 0.25 oo ka yar 0.35.

y-m-59-04.title: Marka pH ka gudubto 3 ilaa 6, imisa jeer ayuu acidity-gu daciifaa?
y-m-59-04.goal: Akhri xogta sida farqiga hal lambar cabbirka logarithm-ka loogu beddelo 'jeer', oo beeni sheegasho si khaldan u fasirta saamiga lambarrada cabbirka sida saamiga isku-ururinta.
y-m-59-04.material:
Aan barano pH, kaas oo muujiya xoogga acidity-ga. Hawshan, waxaan isku raacnay in biyo la dhimay, isku-ururinta hydrogen ion [H⁺] (cutubka mol/L, 'mole halkii litir') la dejiyo [H⁺] = 10^(−pH). (Akhris: 10 awoodda taban pH) 
  
 Xalka | pH | [H⁺] (mol/L) 
 A | 3 | 0.001 
 B | 4 | 0.0001 
 C | 6 | 0.000001 
  
 Donghyun wuxuu yiri, "pH-ka C waa 2 jeer pH-ka A, sidaas darteed C waa 2 jeer ka acidity yar A."

y-m-59-05.title: Dhererka isla giraanta (Ferris wheel) ma lagu qori karaa laba odhaah oo kala duwan?
y-m-59-05.topic: Qaabaynta ifafaalaha soo noqnoqda adigoo isticmaalaya garaafyada hawlaha saddex-xagalka
y-m-59-05.goal: Marka dherer si soo noqnoqda u dhaqaaqaya lagu qorayo odhaah qaabka cosine ah, baar habka xarunta, baaxadda iyo dhaqaajinta ay shuruudaha ku go'aamaan, oo naftaada u dhis laba odhaah oo kala duwan (calaamado kala duwan) oo buuxiya shuruudaha.
y-m-59-05.material:
Giraan (Ferris wheel) ayaa ku wareegaysa xawaare joogto ah, hal wareeg oo buuxa 60 ilbiriqsi. Barta ugu hooseysa waa 2 m dhulka ka sarreysa, barta ugu sarreysana waa 30 m dhulka ka sarreysa. Ha ahaato daqiiqadda rakaabka fuulo t = 0 ilbiriqsi, marka rakaabku joogo barta ugu hooseysa.

Qaabee dhererka rakaabka (cutubka m) sida h(t) = D + A·cos(2π(t − c)/60). (Akhris: cosine ee 2 pi jeer t laga jaray c kor lix tobnaad) D waa dhererka xarunta, A waa lambarka dejiya baaxadda (wuxuu noqon karaa taban), c-na waa xaddiga loo dhaqaajiyay dhanka midig (ilbiriqsi). U xadid 0 ≤ c < 60.
